# Game without an achievement set

Recorded from the live RetroAchievements Web API on 2026-10-10 for
[~Demo~ Three Tribes](https://retroachievements.org/game/34131) (Game Boy Advance).
The game has a supported hash, but no published achievements. The request was
`API_GetGameInfoAndUserProgress` with `g=34131&a=1`.

The response contains `NumAchievements: 0` and `Achievements: {}`. Player and unlock
counts are zero, completion values are `"0.00%"`, and award metadata is null.
No API key, username, or full request URL is recorded.
